# Public test fixtures / 公开测试数据

Only public, synthetic, or explicitly redistributable fixtures belong here. Never add private customer documents.

这里只允许公开、合成或明确允许再分发的测试文件。严禁加入私人客户文档。

Planned fixture matrix: digital PDF, scanned PDF, image, multi page PDF, table, Chinese and English document, missing field, malformed format, and malformed AI response.
